# Vigil

> Vigil is an open source AI SOC: an agentic SOC with specialized
> AI agents, extensible MCP integrations, and community detection rules across Sigma, Splunk, Elastic, and KQL,
> released under Apache 2.0. Local-first: Vigil runs in your environment, and data goes only to the
> services you configure, such as your LLM provider.
> Vigil pairs with LogLM, DeepTempo's cybersecurity foundation model, to form
> the Intelligent Defense Platform.

## Core
- [What is Vigil](https://vigilsoc.org/): agents, workflows, MCP integrations, quick start
- [Documentation](https://vigilsoc.org/docs/): architecture, agents, deploy, contributing
